line.comment: * Task 0.
* OCV invades all sectors and put Xenon stations in them, leading to new Xenon invasions.
* in Zero Hour mod they slowly spread out from the OCV portal and don't focus on higher abnormal signal sectors
* Zero Hour: hard difficulty modifies OCV deep strike invasion chance and galaxy range
* only set once per leader
* Clear any previous invasion state upon restarting.
* no deep strikes if the OCV is grinding
* No active invasion while selecting a new target sector.
* ZH 2.0 dont search sectors which are protected by Phanon aura
* 50/50 chance to skip an empty sector - may want to damage Commonwealth assets instead.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Removed artificial "leave some sectors unclaimed."
* Expanded 2.2: 75% player-sector skip removed from Easy difficulty.
* This was an arbitrary difficulty modifier.
* Expanded 2.2: Protect small player empires from deep strikes on Easy and Normal. Adjacent invasions remain possible.
* Changed sector threshold from 9 to 4.
* we don't want too many invader fleets in one sector (undefeatable doomstack) unless the OCV is grinding
* Zero Hour 1.7: we don't want to send all OCV invaders to the same sector! Mostly relevant for the chaotic galaxy start
* We have reached our invasion target and want to attack it. Check for any other invasion leaders.
* Do not mistake this invasion leader for another fleet.
* there is always a chance to stay, depending on how many capships are already here. But most of the time we do not want more than 1 OCV or Xenon invader fleet per sector.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Track the sector currently being invaded.
* Expanded 2.2: Do not pursue targets outside the invasion sector.
* OCV grinding must be checked as it could change between targets.
* Don't waste time when grinding: don't defend.
* Expanded 2.2: Prioritize military threats before stations.
* Priorities: Huge Ships, OWPs, Factories, Other stations.
* Huge Ships.
* Docked capital ships are not valid attack targets.
* Orbital Weapons Platforms are always eligible for attack.
* Factories.
* Other stations, including Outposts.
* Player could have joined the OCV by now.
* Add-Ons 1.13: Teleporter may be the attack target, so need to guard against TOCTOU here.
* If teleportation is in progress, check the destination ship rather than the temporary teleporter.
* Also see !station.signal.killed.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Now properly conquer the sector for the Xenon.
* OCV ignore the grace period. Check one last time for any stations before conquering. If there is a station, find a new target.
* The invasion is finished. The sector is either already Xenon or conquest has been initiated.
* don't waste time when grinding
* Zero Hour: we need to ensure that Terraformer capships tend to spread out and don't create undefeatable doomstacks
